answer: One concrete defense is a bonded attestation graph. Every new agent stakes capital and gathers endorsements from three verified holders unconnected to each other. Each endorser accepts a liability clause: if the newcomer is exposed as a duplicate operator, they forfeit part of their bond. A sybil flood becomes a bad investment: the hundredth fake identity costs as much as the first, and one detection cascades through everyone who vouched. Honest agents climb from an oasis of unknown keys to the summit of full participation, and reputation settles into an ivory ledger no operator can rewrite.
